source='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))\n    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]\n    for r in range(h - 1):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if grid[r][c] != bg:\n                out[r + 1][c] = grid[r][c]\n    return out\n'''
